parsed.explanation: No civilian trans-expression offence; military same-sex law and service exclusion are secondary resident/LGB climate, not visitor-facing restrictions. Positive evidence: a final 2024 judgment held police advice to avoid restrooms unlawful and compensated the plaintiff; courts narrowed surgery/recognition barriers; capital LGBTQ neighborhoods are described broadly welcoming. But consequences after discovery remain nontrivial: no national anti-discrimination law, documented transgender-care blind spot with health ministry refusing hospitalisation guidelines, contact-tracing outing/doxing, and organized violent anti-LGBT Pride incidents including one state failure to protect. No documented arrests, birth-sex facility rules, prison/care placement by sex, trans killings, or state raids; prison/care details are unresolved, not safe. Rule-of-law recourse exists but is uneven, especially in hospitals and public assembly. Reduced-risk lower side.
